system.biography:
Despite her ambiguous purview, Tethys is a goddess of much distinction in Creation as well as Yu-Shan. In Creation, she is widely known as a patron of runaways, missing persons and exiles, holding sway over the wilderness and forgotten roads. In Heaven she is known to be a goddess of the lost and those who have gone astray, holding sway over desolate and uncharted tracts of the world. Tethys performs a hard service for Creation: she creates situations in which people are banished or become lost, but also guides the lost and prepares them for a return from exile. She demands that those whom she cares for grow strong from their hardships, setting to wandering in her shadow for all eternity those unable to learn from their crisis. Tethys has long favored the Exalted, and of all people to have come into her dominion, she favors the Lunars most, having harbored and aided them on the fringes of the world since the Usurpation. She appears as an attractive ivory-skinned young woman in an armored black dress and cowl, her robes fashioned from strands of the Cloak of Night bound to the moonsilver-tattooed skins of Lunars who willed her their remains.

Source: Glories of the Most High: Luna.
